library._About: Exports are published into the Vale Projects Master Library on this PC, then this one project folder is pushed to app.valegardenhouses.com by the Vale Virtual Server Manager's sync engine. The library folder comes from the engine's own sync map, so the plugin publishes exactly where the push reads from.

aura._About: The Sync Aura tab. The model's GLBs go to the project's ValeVision__AuraRender/Content__AuraScenePackages (pushed, the folder pruned to the set), AURA's API imports them, and the NPR asset proxies sync both ways with AURA's drawing set through AURA's API, signed in as you. The session (never a password) is kept in session_file, on this PC only. Proxies sit on proxy_tag, which must be in the GLB builder's skip range (00, 02 to 06) so they never go into AURA's model. proxy_tag is provisional: not yet a DataLib standard tag.
